title: Original Asterix & Dogmatix Ink Drawing on Paper Double Sided Comic Art
descriptionText:
Priced to sell. Original hand drawn ink illustration featuring Asterix and Dogmatix -- unattributed fan/practice art, not officially licensed Uderzo/Goscinny work.
This is an original ink drawing on cream paper, matted in black. The artwork is double sided.
Front
Black ink illustration of Asterix running with Dogmatix. Clean, confident line work. Hand drawn, not a print or reproduction.
Back
The reverse side contains multiple graphite sketch studies, including:
• Several female portrait studies
• Additional light character sketches
• Rough figure and face studies
• Visible construction lines and working marks
The back clearly shows this was used as a working artist sheet with practice and study drawings.
Artwork Details
Medium: Ink on paper (front), graphite (back)
Paper: Cream tone with visible age
Format: Double sided original artwork
Mat: Black mat included
Condition Notes
• Visible age toning throughout
• Light staining on front lower left area
• Back shows tape residue and paper loss along right edge
• General handling wear consistent with age
• No major tears through main ink illustration
• Please review all photos carefully
This is an original, double sided artist sheet. Sold as unidentified original comic art (unattributed fan/practice piece, not a licensed Asterix product).
